svg.aria-label: Left: training loss for the same model and batches under three step orders: the correct order descends smoothly, forgetting zero_grad dips quickly then blows up past 10, zeroing between backward and step leaves the loss flat. Right: without zero_grad the gradient the optimiser uses grows from under 1 to over 200
